**The problem**

     "Add a feature to do X" is less useful than "I am doing Y and I need X
     because Z". The second one shows what the design has to satisfy. -->

**What you did instead**

<!-- The workaround, if there is one, and what it costs you. -->

**What you would want**

<!-- The shape of the answer, not the implementation. Which service, which
     format, which tool name, which fields. -->

**A note on scope**

<!--
This plugin holds a line: a record never states more than it knows. Where a
fact cannot be established, it is reported as unavailable with a reason
rather than inferred. If your request needs a fact the sources do not carry,
the answer will be "unavailable, because ..." — and that is a feature, not a
failure to fix. Say so in the request if that is what you need, and it will be
built that way.
-->
